fire.smokeFrontSpeed.locator: speed of the modelled smoke front along open floor area (simple spreading zone, not CFD)

fire.doorDelaySec.locator: extra delay for smoke to pass a closed door

fire.riseDelaySec.locator: delay for smoke to rise through a floor opening to the floor above

fire.rampSec.locator: time for smoke level to rise from 0 to 1 after arrival

fire.coreGrowth.locator: growth rate of the impassable fire core radius

fire.smokeCostM.locator: route cost added per cell at full smoke when choosing a path

fire.impassableLevel.locator: smoke level above which a cell's route cost is multiplied by 10 (people avoid it but can still move through it, slowly); only the fire core is impassable

quake.shakeSec.locator: duration of strong shaking during which nobody walks

quake.debrisSpeedFactor.locator: walking speed factor on debris cells near damaged elements

quake.debrisRadiusM.locator: radius of debris around a damaged stair or exit

threat.speed.locator: movement speed of a moving threat zone

threat.radiusM.locator: radius of the threat zone that occupants must leave

threat.noticeRadiusM.locator: distance within which occupants notice the threat directly

medical.radiusM.locator: radius of the keep-clear zone around a medical incident

quake.aftershockWindowSec.locator: period after the main shaking in which people moving (not holding in place) count as exposed to aftershocks and falling debris; EXITMIND modelling assumption, not physics

fire.outdoorPlumeM.locator: on an open-air ground, smoke spreads only this far from the fire, thinning with distance (drifts away instead of filling enclosed rooms); EXITMIND modelling assumption, not physics
